sources.title: Antofagasta miners escalate copper strike with hunger protest
evidence: Workers at an Antofagasta Plc copper mine in Chile escalated a three-day strike Friday
with three union members starting a hunger strike
has offered a 2% real increase in base salaries and a cash bonus of almost $23,000 each.
The company has maintained its production expectations despite the walkout by 709 workers
representing about 22% of Centinela’s own workforce.

sources.title: EAEU, 중국산 무계목 유정용 강관 반덤핑관세 5년 연장
evidence: 유라시아경제연합(EAEU)이 중국산 무계목 유정용 강관(OCTG)에 대한 반덤핑관세 부과기간을 5년 연장했다.
유라시아경제위원회(EEC)는 중국산 무계목 유정용 강관에 대한 반덤핑관세를 2031년 10월 5일까지 연장하기로 결정했다.
적용 세율은 제조업체에 따라 수입품 관세가격의 12.23~31.0%다.
이번 조치는 기존 관세를 유지하는 것으로, 새로운 관세율을 일괄적으로 부과하는 것은 아니다.

sources.title: Trump says Russia to immediately supply 300,000 tons of diesel fuel
evidence: US President Donald Trump said on Friday that Russia had agreed to immediately supply
over 300,000 tons of diesel fuel to the American and global marketplace
Trump added that Russia would then deliver 3 million tons of diesel fuel within a short period of time,
based on the condition of its diesel refineries
would immediately supply another 500,000 tons in November and 1 million tons immediately thereafter.
